[[File:PandoorSomtay-DitC.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Jyl Somtay]] and [[Naj Pandoor]] face a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] in the catacombs.]]{{Quote|I'm sending my warriors to hide in the catacombs.|Poggle the Lesser to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
A set of ''catacombs''{{'}} was a network of tunnels located beneath the red rocky surface of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Every Geonosian building had a series of catacombs running for miles beneath its surface.

==History==
{{Quote|Every Geonosian building has a series of catacombs beneath it that run deep underground.|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]|audio=BlowTheFactory-WF.flac|<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>}}
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] used these tunnels to escape to their ships, safeguarded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who slaughtered any [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] unfortunate enough to enter the catacombs. It was here that Grievous earned his first trophies: lightsabers taken from the bodies of the Jedi he [[Death/Legends|killed]].

[[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] sent the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Geonosian/Legends#Warrior caste|warriors]] to hide in the catacombs after the invasion of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] infiltrated the underground tunnels and killed many of the warriors, as well as [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]] when he tried to escape in his starfighter. They were also used to store large assault forces for emergencies.

During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] navigated the catacombs to reach a critical area inside the Separatist's [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]].<ref name="TCWLOT">"{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}"</ref>
